Incomplete cast silver Roman finger ring, an example of Henig Type XI [?] (Henig 1978). The base of the hoop is missing but the remaining shoulders and bezel are broad and flat with sharp edges. The bezel has a slightly raised broad oval-shaped prominence although this is now very worn.
